S.FORM: kalpacaw nu yi-lang 2026 a mihcaan 伊朗戰爭 (2026年) nikalepacaw nu yi-lang nuyda u yi-lang atu pusewan nu dadipasan a kitidaan kyu mabakuhac kya itidaay malepacaw sat u . .2026 a mihcaan 2 a bulad 28 a demiad , amilika atu yi-se-ley maydih mibelin ku heni tu yi-lang yiselan a mikuwanay , mapulung maydih mikihatihatiya mubelin amibakuhac tina talakaway a tademaw u mikuwanay tapang mukeliday u hikuki balunga nu kaygung muhalhal tu sapamata amikuwang tu u cancanan a kitidaan amubelin tu satalakaway nu yi-lang mikuwanay ayda a tademaw ci Ali.hamini .2026年2月28日, . u yi-lan nadikudan yadah t uku mubahelay a lacu atu kinapatay sananay inayay ku paculilay a hikuki a paculi , ,Yu mikusiw i cungtung a kitidaan nu amilika atu nu yiseley , ,yaitiniay katuuday nu bayu'ay a kanatal u cacukaymasan tu canan mamin a kusiwan mibaetung tu lacu baetungan nu yi-lang , imahini u yi-lang mibakuhac tu makayniay a balunga nu binawlan , ,u tatengaay sa mapuut kina he-mu-ce a kakaydaan nu mukuay tu simal a balunga . .Inani kalpacaw malalid ku liwliway katukuh li-huwan-te atu in-tu-yang a kitidaan , caay kasasulul mahida tu . . namakay 2023 a mihcaan sa , ina cung-tung mahini tu sakatalawan sa , u amilika atu yi-lang inayay kuni kasasulul mangaleb mangaleb .自2023 .Yi-lang atu yi-se-ley 2024 amihcaan atu 2025 a mihcaan kinapina mabakuhac masasuada ;
